metadata.title: Nocturnal Pool Portrait with Reflected Serif Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a woman waist-deep in dark water at night, illuminated by a warm, directional light source from the right. The composition is balanced by two blocks of vertically condensed serif text on either side of the subject, each featuring a mirrored reflection on the water's surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against deep teal/black water
Symmetrical placement of text flanking the central figure
Verticality of the typeface echoing the upright posture of the subject
Soft, grainy film texture unifying the image and text
coreInvariants: Warm, golden-hour style key light on the face
Water surface with soft ripples and clear reflections

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium shot, occupying the middle third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, highlighted by the warm key light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the illuminated face, moves outward to the flanking text blocks, then down to the reflections in the water.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of dark, textured water and night sky provide a quiet, atmospheric backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and charcoal black (water and background).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and peach (skin highlights and lighting).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value contrast between the lit face and the surrounding darkness.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted, earthy, and nocturnal tones

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals

composition.scale: Large enough to balance the subject's head width
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating above the water line with a vertical flip reflection below

treatment.distortion: mirrored and faded for the reflection

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all text to maintain formal symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast.
Classic condensed serif with sharp terminals.
Strong vertical stress and elegant serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic photograph of a woman with dark hair in a white swimsuit, standing in a dark pool at night. Warm golden light hits her face from the side. The water is dark teal with soft ripples. Add heavy film grain and a slightly desaturated, moody color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two blocks of uppercase text in a condensed serif font on either side of the woman's torso. The text should be a pale pink color. Create a vertically flipped reflection of the text directly below it, fading into the water ripples with reduced opacity.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly symmetrical relative to the center?
Does the reflection align with the base of the main text?
Is the lighting on the subject consistent with a single warm source?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the exact name of the artist or album title
Ensure the face does not replicate a specific celebrity likeness

avoid: Low-contrast text that is hard to read

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic water distortion in the reflection
Ensure the grain is consistent across both image and text
Verify the serif terminals are sharp and not rounded
Confirm the color palette remains within the teal/amber/rose range
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key nocturnal portrait with high-contrast condensed serif typography that utilizes a mirrored reflection to ground the text in the environment.
